rust_summary: whether a client entity draws, how opaque, and whether its armour shows (`native_client_entity_render`).
doc_summary: whether a client entity draws, how opaque, and whether its armour shows (`native_client_entity_render(entity_id, kind, alpha, hide_armor, cancel)`): asked each frame for every mob, player, armor stand, dropped item, projectile and display about to draw. A mod sets `alpha` below 1.0 to draw it translucent, `hide_armor` to leave out its worn armour and head item, or cancels to skip it (model, layers, held items and outline). Drawing only: the entity stays in the world, and its name tag is `native_render_name_tag`. Bundles need "hooks": @API:client_entity_render@.
